<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!-- SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0 -->
<project xmlns="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0"
         xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
         xsi:schemaLocation="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0 https://maven.apache.org/xsd/maven-4.0.0.xsd">
  <modelVersion>4.0.0</modelVersion>

  <parent>
    <groupId>com.synexia</groupId>
    <artifactId>synexia-parent</artifactId>
    <version>${revision}</version>
    <relativePath>../pom.xml</relativePath>
  </parent>

  <artifactId>synexia-openrewrite-recipes</artifactId>
  <packaging>jar</packaging>
  <name>Synexia :: OpenRewrite Recipes</name>
  <description>Java 21 class-backed OpenRewrite recipes for M3/IOP proof-gated mechanical source transforms.</description>

  <properties>
    <!-- rewrite-maven-plugin 5.23.1 embeds OpenRewrite 8.17.1; keep the recipe ABI aligned. -->
    <openrewrite.core.version>8.17.1</openrewrite.core.version>
    <m3.iop.rewrite.plugin.version>5.23.1</m3.iop.rewrite.plugin.version>
    <openrewrite.test.junit.version>5.10.2</openrewrite.test.junit.version>
    <m3.iop.mutation.recipe>com.synexia.rewrite.M3IopPatternOnlySerialMechanicalJavaRecipe</m3.iop.mutation.recipe>
  </properties>

  <dependencies>
    <!-- Public IProblem bridge only; downstream hosts explicitly opt into the compiler SDK. -->
    <dependency>
      <groupId>org.eclipse.jdt</groupId>
      <artifactId>ecj</artifactId>
      <version>3.46.100</version>
      <optional>true</optional>
    </dependency>
    <!-- Standalone ASTParser/ECJ regression execution, not an installed Eclipse runtime. -->
    <dependency>
      <groupId>org.eclipse.jdt</groupId>
      <artifactId>org.eclipse.jdt.core</artifactId>
      <version>3.47.0</version>
      <scope>test</scope>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>com.synexia</groupId>
      <artifactId>m3-java-contracts</artifactId>
      <version>${revision}</version>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>com.synexia</groupId>
      <artifactId>m3-java-inventory</artifactId>
      <version>${revision}</version>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>com.synexia.iop</groupId>
      <artifactId>synexia-iop</artifactId>
      <version>${revision}</version>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>com.synexia.build</groupId>
      <artifactId>synexia-build-inventory</artifactId>
      <version>${revision}</version>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>com.synexia</groupId>
      <artifactId>synexia-ccore</artifactId>
      <version>${revision}</version>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>com.synexia.algorithms</groupId>
      <artifactId>synexia-algorithms</artifactId>
      <version>${revision}</version>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>com.synexia</groupId>
      <artifactId>synexia-etl</artifactId>
      <version>${revision}</version>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>com.synexia</groupId>
      <artifactId>synexia-etl-dfs</artifactId>
      <version>${revision}</version>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>com.synexia</groupId>
      <artifactId>synexia-flink-datastream</artifactId>
      <version>${revision}</version>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>com.synexia</groupId>
      <artifactId>synexia-beam-etl</artifactId>
      <version>${revision}</version>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>com.synexia.cognix</groupId>
      <artifactId>synexia-fastsearch</artifactId>
      <version>${revision}</version>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>com.synexia</groupId>
      <artifactId>synexia-chrome2api-java</artifactId>
      <version>${revision}</version>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>com.synexia</groupId>
      <artifactId>m3-fast-search</artifactId>
      <version>${revision}</version>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>com.synexia</groupId>
      <artifactId>synexia-classic-tools</artifactId>
      <version>${revision}</version>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>com.synexia.cognix</groupId>
      <artifactId>synexia-donor-inventory</artifactId>
      <version>${revision}</version>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>com.synexia</groupId>
      <artifactId>synexia-index-precompute</artifactId>
      <version>${revision}</version>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>com.synexia</groupId>
      <artifactId>synexia-sap-compat</artifactId>
      <version>${revision}</version>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>com.synexia</groupId>
      <artifactId>synexia-job</artifactId>
      <version>${revision}</version>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>com.synexia</groupId>
      <artifactId>synexia-indexstring</artifactId>
      <version>${revision}</version>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>org.openrewrite</groupId>
      <artifactId>rewrite-core</artifactId>
      <version>${openrewrite.core.version}</version>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>org.openrewrite</groupId>
      <artifactId>rewrite-java</artifactId>
      <version>${openrewrite.core.version}</version>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>org.openrewrite</groupId>
      <artifactId>rewrite-java-21</artifactId>
      <version>${openrewrite.core.version}</version>
      <scope>runtime</scope>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>org.openrewrite</groupId>
      <artifactId>rewrite-groovy</artifactId>
      <version>${openrewrite.core.version}</version>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>org.openrewrite</groupId>
      <artifactId>rewrite-gradle</artifactId>
      <version>${openrewrite.core.version}</version>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>org.openrewrite</groupId>
      <artifactId>rewrite-hcl</artifactId>
      <version>${openrewrite.core.version}</version>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>org.openrewrite</groupId>
      <artifactId>rewrite-protobuf</artifactId>
      <version>${openrewrite.core.version}</version>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>org.openrewrite</groupId>
      <artifactId>rewrite-yaml</artifactId>
      <version>${openrewrite.core.version}</version>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>org.openrewrite</groupId>
      <artifactId>rewrite-xml</artifactId>
      <version>${openrewrite.core.version}</version>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>org.openrewrite</groupId>
      <artifactId>rewrite-json</artifactId>
      <version>${openrewrite.core.version}</version>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>org.openrewrite</groupId>
      <artifactId>rewrite-properties</artifactId>
      <version>${openrewrite.core.version}</version>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>org.openrewrite</groupId>
      <artifactId>rewrite-maven</artifactId>
      <version>${openrewrite.core.version}</version>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>org.openrewrite</groupId>
      <artifactId>rewrite-test</artifactId>
      <version>${openrewrite.core.version}</version>
      <scope>test</scope>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>org.slf4j</groupId>
      <artifactId>slf4j-api</artifactId>
    </dependency>
    <!--
      Invoked only as an external recipe pack. Its implementation is not copied or adapted.
      Keep it optional so downstream users choose that separately licensed candidate lane explicitly.
    -->
    <dependency>
      <groupId>org.openrewrite.recipe</groupId>
      <artifactId>rewrite-static-analysis</artifactId>
      <version>1.4.2</version>
      <scope>runtime</scope>
      <optional>true</optional>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>org.junit.jupiter</groupId>
      <artifactId>junit-jupiter</artifactId>
      <version>${openrewrite.test.junit.version}</version>
      <scope>test</scope>
    </dependency>
  </dependencies>

  <build>
    <plugins>
      <!-- The sole module-local source-candidate mutator. No mutating goal is lifecycle-bound. -->
      <plugin>
        <groupId>org.openrewrite.maven</groupId>
        <artifactId>rewrite-maven-plugin</artifactId>
        <version>${m3.iop.rewrite.plugin.version}</version>
      </plugin>

      <!-- Build/proof helpers are declared locally so the module is mechanically self-describing. -->
      <plugin>
        <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
        <artifactId>maven-compiler-plugin</artifactId>
        <version>${m3.compiler.version}</version>
        <configuration>
          <release>21</release>
          <proc>none</proc>
          <parameters>true</parameters>
          <compilerArgs>
            <arg>-Xlint:all</arg>
            <arg>-Werror</arg>
          </compilerArgs>
        </configuration>
      </plugin>

      <plugin>
        <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
        <artifactId>maven-surefire-plugin</artifactId>
        <version>${m3.surefire.version}</version>
        <configuration>
          <useModulePath>false</useModulePath>
        </configuration>
      </plugin>

      <plugin>
        <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
        <artifactId>maven-failsafe-plugin</artifactId>
        <version>${m3.surefire.version}</version>
      </plugin>

      <plugin>
        <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
        <artifactId>maven-enforcer-plugin</artifactId>
        <version>${m3.enforcer.version}</version>
      </plugin>

      <plugin>
        <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
        <artifactId>maven-checkstyle-plugin</artifactId>
        <version>${m3.checkstyle.plugin.version}</version>
      </plugin>

      <plugin>
        <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
        <artifactId>maven-pmd-plugin</artifactId>
        <version>${m3.pmd.plugin.version}</version>
      </plugin>

      <plugin>
        <groupId>com.github.spotbugs</groupId>
        <artifactId>spotbugs-maven-plugin</artifactId>
        <version>${m3.spotbugs.plugin.version}</version>
      </plugin>

      <plugin>
        <groupId>com.diffplug.spotless</groupId>
        <artifactId>spotless-maven-plugin</artifactId>
        <version>${m3.spotless.version}</version>
      </plugin>

      <plugin>
        <groupId>org.jacoco</groupId>
        <artifactId>jacoco-maven-plugin</artifactId>
        <version>${m3.jacoco.version}</version>
      </plugin>

      <plugin>
        <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
        <artifactId>maven-dependency-plugin</artifactId>
        <version>${m3.dependency.version}</version>
      </plugin>

      <plugin>
        <groupId>org.cyclonedx</groupId>
        <artifactId>cyclonedx-maven-plugin</artifactId>
        <version>${m3.cyclonedx.version}</version>
      </plugin>
    </plugins>
  </build>

  <profiles>
    <profile>
      <id>m3-tutorial-reference-search</id>
      <build>
        <plugins>
          <plugin>
            <groupId>org.openrewrite.maven</groupId>
            <artifactId>rewrite-maven-plugin</artifactId>
            <version>${m3.iop.rewrite.plugin.version}</version>
            <configuration>
              <failOnInvalidActiveRecipes>true</failOnInvalidActiveRecipes>
              <failOnDryRunResults>false</failOnDryRunResults>
              <exportDatatables>true</exportDatatables>
              <activeRecipes>
                <recipe>com.synexia.rewrite.M3TutorialReferenceSearch</recipe>
              </activeRecipes>
            </configuration>
          </plugin>
        </plugins>
      </build>
    </profile>

    <profile>
      <id>m3-tutorial-reference-all</id>
      <build>
        <plugins>
          <plugin>
            <groupId>org.openrewrite.maven</groupId>
            <artifactId>rewrite-maven-plugin</artifactId>
            <version>${m3.iop.rewrite.plugin.version}</version>
            <configuration>
              <failOnInvalidActiveRecipes>true</failOnInvalidActiveRecipes>
              <failOnDryRunResults>false</failOnDryRunResults>
              <exportDatatables>true</exportDatatables>
              <activeRecipes>
                <recipe>com.synexia.rewrite.M3TutorialReferenceAll</recipe>
              </activeRecipes>
            </configuration>
          </plugin>
        </plugins>
      </build>
    </profile>

    <profile>
      <id>m3-enterprise-application-pack</id>
      <build>
        <plugins>
          <plugin>
            <groupId>org.openrewrite.maven</groupId>
            <artifactId>rewrite-maven-plugin</artifactId>
            <version>${m3.iop.rewrite.plugin.version}</version>
            <configuration>
              <failOnInvalidActiveRecipes>true</failOnInvalidActiveRecipes>
              <failOnDryRunResults>false</failOnDryRunResults>
              <exportDatatables>true</exportDatatables>
              <activeRecipes>
                <recipe>com.synexia.rewrite.M3EnterpriseApplicationPack</recipe>
              </activeRecipes>
            </configuration>
          </plugin>
        </plugins>
      </build>
    </profile>

    <profile>
      <id>m3-openrewrite-mindexast-delivery</id>
      <build>
        <plugins>
          <plugin>
            <groupId>org.openrewrite.maven</groupId>
            <artifactId>rewrite-maven-plugin</artifactId>
            <version>${m3.iop.rewrite.plugin.version}</version>
            <configuration>
              <activeRecipes>
                <recipe>com.synexia.rewrite.M3OpenRewriteMIndexAstInstallationRecipe</recipe>
              </activeRecipes>
              <failOnInvalidActiveRecipes>true</failOnInvalidActiveRecipes>
              <failOnDryRunResults>false</failOnDryRunResults>
            </configuration>
          </plugin>
        </plugins>
      </build>
    </profile>
    <profile>
      <id>m3-openrewrite-mindexast</id>
      <build>
        <plugins>
          <plugin>
            <groupId>org.openrewrite.maven</groupId>
            <artifactId>rewrite-maven-plugin</artifactId>
            <version>${m3.iop.rewrite.plugin.version}</version>
            <configuration>
              <activeRecipes>
                <recipe>com.synexia.rewrite.M3OpenRewriteOnMIndexAstProofRecipe</recipe>
              </activeRecipes>
              <failOnInvalidActiveRecipes>true</failOnInvalidActiveRecipes>
              <exportDatatables>true</exportDatatables>
              <failOnDryRunResults>false</failOnDryRunResults>
            </configuration>
          </plugin>
        </plugins>
      </build>
    </profile>
    <profile>
      <id>m3-openrewrite-sourcej-mindex</id>
      <build>
        <plugins>
          <plugin>
            <groupId>org.openrewrite.maven</groupId>
            <artifactId>rewrite-maven-plugin</artifactId>
            <version>${m3.iop.rewrite.plugin.version}</version>
            <configuration>
              <activeRecipes combine.self="override">
                <recipe>com.synexia.rewrite.M3OpenRewriteSourceJInlineRecipe</recipe>
              </activeRecipes>
              <failOnInvalidActiveRecipes>true</failOnInvalidActiveRecipes>
              <exportDatatables>true</exportDatatables>
              <failOnDryRunResults>false</failOnDryRunResults>
            </configuration>
          </plugin>
        </plugins>
      </build>
    </profile>

    <profile>
      <id>m3-openrewrite-sourcej-mindex-proof</id>
      <build>
        <plugins>
          <plugin>
            <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
            <artifactId>maven-surefire-plugin</artifactId>
            <configuration>
              <useModulePath>false</useModulePath>
              <includes>
                <include>**/MIndexOpenRewriteSourceJCompilerTest.java</include>
              </includes>
              <failIfNoTests>true</failIfNoTests>
            </configuration>
          </plugin>
        </plugins>
      </build>
    </profile>

    <!-- Read-only exact-file behavior inventory for an OpenRewrite Recipe implementation. -->
    <profile>
      <id>m3-openrewrite-recipe-behavior-inventory</id>
      <build>
        <plugins>
          <plugin>
            <groupId>org.openrewrite.maven</groupId>
            <artifactId>rewrite-maven-plugin</artifactId>
            <configuration>
              <failOnInvalidActiveRecipes>true</failOnInvalidActiveRecipes>
              <exportDatatables>true</exportDatatables>
              <activeRecipes>
                <recipe>com.synexia.rewrite.M3OpenRewriteRecipeBehaviorInventory</recipe>
              </activeRecipes>
            </configuration>
          </plugin>
        </plugins>
      </build>
    </profile>

    <!-- Candidate-only serial mechanical rewrite, gated by attributed Recipe behavior. -->
    <profile>
      <id>m3-openrewrite-recipe-patternized-serial</id>
      <build>
        <plugins>
          <plugin>
            <groupId>org.openrewrite.maven</groupId>
            <artifactId>rewrite-maven-plugin</artifactId>
            <configuration>
              <failOnInvalidActiveRecipes>true</failOnInvalidActiveRecipes>
              <exportDatatables>true</exportDatatables>
              <activeRecipes>
                <recipe>com.synexia.rewrite.M3OpenRewriteRecipePatternizedSerial</recipe>
              </activeRecipes>
            </configuration>
          </plugin>
        </plugins>
      </build>
    </profile>

    <!-- Restore the reviewed exact SHA-256 batch entry point. -->
    <profile>
      <id>m3-mindex-sha256-batch</id>
      <build>
        <plugins>
          <plugin>
            <groupId>org.openrewrite.maven</groupId>
            <artifactId>rewrite-maven-plugin</artifactId>
            <configuration>
              <failOnInvalidActiveRecipes>true</failOnInvalidActiveRecipes>
              <activeRecipes>
                <recipe>com.synexia.rewrite.M3MIndexSha256BatchRecipe</recipe>
              </activeRecipes>
            </configuration>
          </plugin>
        </plugins>
      </build>
    </profile>

    <!-- Keep platform/category pairings through tri-platform candidate fan-in. -->
    <profile>
      <id>m3-platform-scoped-category</id>
      <build>
        <plugins>
          <plugin>
            <groupId>org.openrewrite.maven</groupId>
            <artifactId>rewrite-maven-plugin</artifactId>
            <configuration>
              <failOnInvalidActiveRecipes>true</failOnInvalidActiveRecipes>
              <activeRecipes>
                <recipe>com.synexia.rewrite.M3PlatformScopedCategoryQueryRecipe</recipe>
              </activeRecipes>
            </configuration>
          </plugin>
        </plugins>
      </build>
    </profile>

    <!-- Candidate-only repository-wide additive-superset review. DataTable retention is host/SDK-owned. -->
    <profile>
      <id>m3-repository-superset-review</id>
      <build>
        <plugins>
          <plugin>
            <groupId>org.openrewrite.maven</groupId>
            <artifactId>rewrite-maven-plugin</artifactId>
            <configuration>
              <activeRecipes>
                <recipe>com.synexia.rewrite.M3RepositorySupersetReviewRecipe</recipe>
                <recipe>com.synexia.rewrite.M3ChallengeDonorReviewRecipe</recipe>
              </activeRecipes>
            </configuration>
          </plugin>
        </plugins>
      </build>
    </profile>

    <!-- Candidate-only search over the existing immutable challenge posting index. -->
    <profile>
      <id>m3-challenge-fast-search-review</id>
      <build>
        <plugins>
          <plugin>
            <groupId>org.openrewrite.maven</groupId>
            <artifactId>rewrite-maven-plugin</artifactId>
            <configuration>
              <activeRecipes>
                <recipe>com.synexia.rewrite.M3ChallengeFastSearchReviewRecipe</recipe>
              </activeRecipes>
            </configuration>
          </plugin>
        </plugins>
      </build>
    </profile>

    <!-- Candidate-only challenge category -> executable GPU-tool binding review. -->
    <profile>
      <id>m3-challenge-gpu-tool-review</id>
      <build>
        <plugins>
          <plugin>
            <groupId>org.openrewrite.maven</groupId>
            <artifactId>rewrite-maven-plugin</artifactId>
            <configuration>
              <failOnInvalidActiveRecipes>true</failOnInvalidActiveRecipes>
              <activeRecipes>
                <recipe>com.synexia.ChallengeGpuToolReview</recipe>
              </activeRecipes>
            </configuration>
          </plugin>
        </plugins>
      </build>
    </profile>

    <!-- Candidate-only challenge/native donor review. Exports OpenRewrite DataTables; never mutates source. -->
    <profile>
      <id>m3-challenge-donor-review</id>
      <build>
        <plugins>
          <plugin>
            <groupId>org.openrewrite.maven</groupId>
            <artifactId>rewrite-maven-plugin</artifactId>
            <configuration>
<activeRecipes>
                <recipe>com.synexia.rewrite.M3ChallengeDonorReviewRecipe</recipe>
              </activeRecipes>
            </configuration>
          </plugin>
        </plugins>
      </build>
    </profile>

    <!-- Candidate-only challenge problem/donor consistency review: balanced metadata + license provenance. -->
    <profile>
      <id>m3-challenge-donor-evidence-consistency</id>
      <build>
        <plugins>
          <plugin>
            <groupId>org.openrewrite.maven</groupId>
            <artifactId>rewrite-maven-plugin</artifactId>
            <configuration>
              <failOnInvalidActiveRecipes>true</failOnInvalidActiveRecipes>
              <exportDatatables>true</exportDatatables>
              <activeRecipes>
                <recipe>com.synexia.rewrite.M3ChallengeDonorEvidenceConsistency</recipe>
              </activeRecipes>
            </configuration>
          </plugin>
        </plugins>
      </build>
    </profile>

    <!-- Candidate-only tri-platform donor pass ledger: serial next-action evidence, no source mutation. -->
    <profile>
      <id>m3-challenge-donor-pass-ledger</id>
      <build>
        <plugins>
          <plugin>
            <groupId>org.openrewrite.maven</groupId>
            <artifactId>rewrite-maven-plugin</artifactId>
            <configuration>
              <failOnInvalidActiveRecipes>true</failOnInvalidActiveRecipes>
              <activeRecipes>
                <recipe>com.synexia.rewrite.M3ChallengeDonorPassLedger</recipe>
              </activeRecipes>
            </configuration>
          </plugin>
        </plugins>
      </build>
    </profile>

    <!-- Candidate-only serial C/C++/GPU donor comparison before JNI/native admission. -->
    <profile>
      <id>m3-native-donor-serial-review</id>
      <build>
        <plugins>
          <plugin>
            <groupId>org.openrewrite.maven</groupId>
            <artifactId>rewrite-maven-plugin</artifactId>
            <configuration>
              <failOnInvalidActiveRecipes>true</failOnInvalidActiveRecipes>
              <exportDatatables>true</exportDatatables>
              <activeRecipes>
                <recipe>com.synexia.rewrite.M3NativeDonorSerialReviewRecipe</recipe>
              </activeRecipes>
            </configuration>
          </plugin>
        </plugins>
      </build>
    </profile>

    <!-- Candidate-only tri-source mechanical donor shape review before recipe-crate implementation. -->
    <profile>
      <id>m3-mechanical-donor-shape-review</id>
      <build>
        <plugins>
          <plugin>
            <groupId>org.openrewrite.maven</groupId>
            <artifactId>rewrite-maven-plugin</artifactId>
            <configuration>
              <failOnInvalidActiveRecipes>true</failOnInvalidActiveRecipes>
              <exportDatatables>true</exportDatatables>
              <activeRecipes>
                <recipe>com.synexia.rewrite.M3MechanicalDonorShapeReviewRecipe</recipe>
              </activeRecipes>
            </configuration>
          </plugin>
        </plugins>
      </build>
    </profile>

    <!-- Source-sealed replay for the catalogued algorithm-atom mechanical donor custody slice. -->
    <profile>
      <id>m3-algorithm-atom-mechanical-donor-binding-install</id>
      <build>
        <plugins>
          <plugin>
            <groupId>org.openrewrite.maven</groupId>
            <artifactId>rewrite-maven-plugin</artifactId>
            <configuration>
              <failOnInvalidActiveRecipes>true</failOnInvalidActiveRecipes>
              <activeRecipes>
                <recipe>com.synexia.rewrite.M3AlgorithmAtomMechanicalDonorBindingInstallation</recipe>
              </activeRecipes>
            </configuration>
          </plugin>
        </plugins>
      </build>
    </profile>

    <!-- Source-sealed replay for mechanical donor custody in source-bound serial atom review. -->
    <profile>
      <id>m3-serial-atom-mechanical-donor-binding-install</id>
      <build>
        <plugins>
          <plugin>
            <groupId>org.openrewrite.maven</groupId>
            <artifactId>rewrite-maven-plugin</artifactId>
            <configuration>
              <failOnInvalidActiveRecipes>true</failOnInvalidActiveRecipes>
              <activeRecipes>
                <recipe>com.synexia.rewrite.M3SerialAtomMechanicalDonorBindingInstallation</recipe>
              </activeRecipes>
            </configuration>
          </plugin>
        </plugins>
      </build>
    </profile>

    <!-- Preserve mechanical donor custody through the final executed Java contract receipt. -->
    <profile>
      <id>m3-mechanical-executed-contract-install</id>
      <build>
        <plugins>
          <plugin>
            <groupId>org.openrewrite.maven</groupId>
            <artifactId>rewrite-maven-plugin</artifactId>
            <configuration>

    <profile>
      <id>m3-recipe-laboratory</id>
      <properties>
        <m3.recipeLab.maxFeatures>2</m3.recipeLab.maxFeatures>
        <m3.recipeLab.maxFixtures>8</m3.recipeLab.maxFixtures>
        <m3.recipeLab.maxSequenceLength>2</m3.recipeLab.maxSequenceLength>
        <m3.recipeLab.maxCycles>4</m3.recipeLab.maxCycles>

        <m3.recipeLab.report>${project.build.directory}/m3-recipe-laboratory/regression.tsv</m3.recipeLab.report>
      </properties>
      <build>
        <plugins>
          <plugin>
            <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
            <artifactId>maven-surefire-plugin</artifactId>
            <configuration combine.self="override">
              <useModulePath>false</useModulePath>
              <includes>
                <include>**/M3RecipeLaboratoryTest.java</include>
                <include>**/M3RecipeLaboratorySignalFanInTest.java</include>
              </includes>
              <failIfNoTests>true</failIfNoTests>
            </configuration>
          </plugin>
          <plugin>
            <groupId>org.jacoco</groupId>
            <artifactId>jacoco-maven-plugin</artifactId>
            <executions>
              <execution>
                <id>m3-recipe-laboratory-cache-agent</id>
                <goals><goal>prepare-agent</goal></goals>
              </execution>
              <execution>
                <id>m3-recipe-laboratory-cache-report</id>
                <phase>verify</phase>
                <goals><goal>report</goal></goals>
              </execution>
              <execution>
                <id>m3-recipe-laboratory-cache-check</id>
                <phase>verify</phase>
                <goals><goal>check</goal></goals>
                <configuration>
                  <includes>
                    <include>com/synexia/rewrite/M3RecipeLaboratory$EvaluationCache*</include>
                  </includes>
                  <rules>
                    <rule>
                      <element>BUNDLE</element>
                      <limits>
                        <limit>
                          <counter>LINE</counter>
                          <value>COVEREDRATIO</value>
                          <minimum>0.99</minimum>
                        </limit>
                        <limit>
                          <counter>BRANCH</counter>
                          <value>COVEREDRATIO</value>
                          <minimum>0.99</minimum>
                        </limit>
                      </limits>
                    </rule>
                  </rules>
                </configuration>
              </execution>
            </executions>
          </plugin>
          <plugin>
            <groupId>org.codehaus.mojo</groupId>
            <artifactId>exec-maven-plugin</artifactId>
            <executions>
              <execution>
                <id>m3-recipe-laboratory-regression</id>
                <phase>verify</phase>
                <goals><goal>java</goal></goals>
                <configuration>
                  <mainClass>com.synexia.rewrite.M3RecipeLaboratoryCli</mainClass>
                  <arguments>
                    <argument>${m3.recipeLab.report}</argument>
                    <argument>${m3.recipeLab.maxFeatures}</argument>
                    <argument>${m3.recipeLab.maxFixtures}</argument>
                    <argument>${m3.recipeLab.maxSequenceLength}</argument>
                    <argument>${m3.recipeLab.maxCycles}</argument>
                    <argument>${m3.recipeLab.maxCandidates}</argument>
                  </arguments>
                  <cleanupDaemonThreads>false</cleanupDaemonThreads>
                </configuration>
              </execution>
            </executions>
          </plugin>
        </plugins>
      </build>
    </profile>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!-- SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0 -->
<project xmlns="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0"
         xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
         xsi:schemaLocation="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0 https://maven.apache.org/xsd/maven-4.0.0.xsd">
  <modelVersion>4.0.0</modelVersion>

  <parent>
    <groupId>com.synexia</groupId>
    <artifactId>synexia-parent</artifactId>
    <version>${revision}</version>
    <relativePath>../pom.xml</relativePath>
  </parent>

  <artifactId>synexia-openrewrite-recipes</artifactId>
  <packaging>jar</packaging>
  <name>Synexia :: OpenRewrite Recipes</name>
  <description>Java 21 class-backed OpenRewrite recipes for M3/IOP proof-gated mechanical source transforms.</description>

  <properties>
    <!-- rewrite-maven-plugin 5.23.1 embeds OpenRewrite 8.17.1; keep the recipe ABI aligned. -->
    <openrewrite.core.version>8.17.1</openrewrite.core.version>
    <m3.iop.rewrite.plugin.version>5.23.1</m3.iop.rewrite.plugin.version>
    <openrewrite.test.junit.version>5.10.2</openrewrite.test.junit.version>
    <m3.iop.mutation.recipe>com.synexia.rewrite.M3IopPatternOnlySerialMechanicalJavaRecipe</m3.iop.mutation.recipe>
  </properties>

  <dependencies>
    <!-- Public IProblem bridge only; downstream hosts explicitly opt into the compiler SDK. -->
    <dependency>
      <groupId>org.eclipse.jdt</groupId>
      <artifactId>ecj</artifactId>
      <version>3.46.100</version>
      <optional>true</optional>
    </dependency>
    <!-- Standalone ASTParser/ECJ regression execution, not an installed Eclipse runtime. -->
    <dependency>
      <groupId>org.eclipse.jdt</groupId>
      <artifactId>org.eclipse.jdt.core</artifactId>
      <version>3.47.0</version>
      <scope>test</scope>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>com.synexia</groupId>
      <artifactId>m3-java-contracts</artifactId>
      <version>${revision}</version>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>com.synexia</groupId>
      <artifactId>m3-java-inventory</artifactId>
      <version>${revision}</version>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>com.synexia.iop</groupId>
      <artifactId>synexia-iop</artifactId>
      <version>${revision}</version>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>com.synexia.build</groupId>
      <artifactId>synexia-build-inventory</artifactId>
      <version>${revision}</version>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>com.synexia</groupId>
      <artifactId>synexia-ccore</artifactId>
      <version>${revision}</version>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>com.synexia.algorithms</groupId>
      <artifactId>synexia-algorithms</artifactId>
      <version>${revision}</version>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>com.synexia</groupId>
      <artifactId>synexia-etl</artifactId>
      <version>${revision}</version>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>com.synexia</groupId>
      <artifactId>synexia-etl-dfs</artifactId>
      <version>${revision}</version>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>com.synexia</groupId>
      <artifactId>synexia-flink-datastream</artifactId>
      <version>${revision}</version>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>com.synexia</groupId>
      <artifactId>synexia-beam-etl</artifactId>
      <version>${revision}</version>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>com.synexia.cognix</groupId>
      <artifactId>synexia-fastsearch</artifactId>
      <version>${revision}</version>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>com.synexia</groupId>
      <artifactId>synexia-chrome2api-java</artifactId>
      <version>${revision}</version>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>com.synexia</groupId>

      <version>${revision}</version>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>com.synexia</groupId>
      <artifactId>synexia-classic-tools</artifactId>
      <version>${revision}</version>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>com.synexia.cognix</groupId>
      <artifactId>synexia-donor-inventory</artifactId>
      <version>${revision}</version>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>com.synexia</groupId>
      <artifactId>synexia-index-precompute</artifactId>
      <version>${revision}</version>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>com.synexia</groupId>
      <artifactId>synexia-sap-compat</artifactId>
      <version>${revision}</version>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>com.synexia</groupId>
      <artifactId>synexia-job</artifactId>
      <version>${revision}</version>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>com.synexia</groupId>
      <artifactId>synexia-indexstring</artifactId>
      <version>${revision}</version>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>org.openrewrite</groupId>
      <artifactId>rewrite-core</artifactId>
      <version>${openrewrite.core.version}</version>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>org.openrewrite</groupId>
      <artifactId>rewrite-java</artifactId>
      <version>${openrewrite.core.version}</version>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>org.openrewrite</groupId>
      <artifactId>rewrite-java-21</artifactId>
      <version>${openrewrite.core.version}</version>
      <scope>runtime</scope>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>org.openrewrite</groupId>
      <artifactId>rewrite-groovy</artifactId>
      <version>${openrewrite.core.version}</version>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>org.openrewrite</groupId>
      <artifactId>rewrite-gradle</artifactId>
      <version>${openrewrite.core.version}</version>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>org.openrewrite</groupId>
      <artifactId>rewrite-hcl</artifactId>
      <version>${openrewrite.core.version}</version>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>org.openrewrite</groupId>
      <artifactId>rewrite-protobuf</artifactId>
      <version>${openrewrite.core.version}</version>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>org.openrewrite</groupId>
      <artifactId>rewrite-yaml</artifactId>
      <version>${openrewrite.core.version}</version>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>org.openrewrite</groupId>
      <artifactId>rewrite-xml</artifactId>
      <version>${openrewrite.core.version}</version>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>org.openrewrite</groupId>
      <artifactId>rewrite-json</artifactId>
      <version>${openrewrite.core.version}</version>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>org.openrewrite</groupId>
      <artifactId>rewrite-properties</artifactId>
      <version>${openrewrite.core.version}</version>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>org.openrewrite</groupId>
      <artifactId>rewrite-maven</artifactId>
      <version>${openrewrite.core.version}</version>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>org.openrewrite</groupId>
      <artifactId>rewrite-test</artifactId>
      <version>${openrewrite.core.version}</version>
      <scope>test</scope>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>org.slf4j</groupId>
      <artifactId>slf4j-api</artifactId>
    </dependency>
    <!--
      Invoked only as an external recipe pack. Its implementation is not copied or adapted.
      Keep it optional so downstream users choose that separately licensed candidate lane explicitly.
    -->
    <dependency>
      <groupId>org.openrewrite.recipe</groupId>
      <artifactId>rewrite-static-analysis</artifactId>
      <version>1.4.2</version>
      <scope>runtime</scope>
      <optional>true</optional>
    </dependency>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>org.junit.jupiter</groupId>
      <artifactId>junit-jupiter</artifactId>
      <version>${openrewrite.test.junit.version}</version>
      <scope>test</scope>
    </dependency>
  </dependencies>

  <build>
    <plugins>
      <!-- The sole module-local source-candidate mutator. No mutating goal is lifecycle-bound. -->
      <plugin>
        <groupId>org.openrewrite.maven</groupId>
        <artifactId>rewrite-maven-plugin</artifactId>
        <version>${m3.iop.rewrite.plugin.version}</version>
      </plugin>

      <!-- Build/proof helpers are declared locally so the module is mechanically self-describing. -->
      <plugin>
        <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
        <artifactId>maven-compiler-plugin</artifactId>
        <version>${m3.compiler.version}</version>
        <configuration>
          <release>21</release>
          <proc>none</proc>
          <parameters>true</parameters>
          <compilerArgs>
            <arg>-Xlint:all</arg>
            <arg>-Werror</arg>
          </compilerArgs>
        </configuration>
      </plugin>

      <plugin>
        <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
        <artifactId>maven-surefire-plugin</artifactId>
        <version>${m3.surefire.version}</version>
        <configuration>
          <useModulePath>false</useModulePath>
        </configuration>
      </plugin>

      <plugin>
        <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
        <artifactId>maven-failsafe-plugin</artifactId>
        <version>${m3.surefire.version}</version>
      </plugin>

      <plugin>
        <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
        <artifactId>maven-enforcer-plugin</artifactId>
        <version>${m3.enforcer.version}</version>
      </plugin>

      <plugin>
        <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
        <artifactId>maven-checkstyle-plugin</artifactId>
        <version>${m3.checkstyle.plugin.version}</version>
      </plugin>

      <plugin>
        <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
        <artifactId>maven-pmd-plugin</artifactId>
        <version>${m3.pmd.plugin.version}</version>
      </plugin>

      <plugin>
        <groupId>com.github.spotbugs</groupId>
        <artifactId>spotbugs-maven-plugin</artifactId>
        <version>${m3.spotbugs.plugin.version}</version>
      </plugin>

      <plugin>
        <groupId>com.diffplug.spotless</groupId>
        <artifactId>spotless-maven-plugin</artifactId>
        <version>${m3.spotless.version}</version>
      </plugin>

      <plugin>
        <groupId>org.jacoco</groupId>
        <artifactId>jacoco-maven-plugin</artifactId>
        <version>${m3.jacoco.version}</version>
      </plugin>

      <plugin>
        <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
        <artifactId>maven-dependency-plugin</artifactId>
        <version>${m3.dependency.version}</version>
      </plugin>

      <plugin>
        <groupId>org.cyclonedx</groupId>
        <artifactId>cyclonedx-maven-plugin</artifactId>
        <version>${m3.cyclonedx.version}</version>
      </plugin>
    </plugins>
  </build>

  <profiles>
    <profile>

            </configuration>
          </plugin>

    <profile>
      <id>m3-tutorial-reference-all</id>
      <build>
        <plugins>
          <plugin>

    <profile>

            <artifactId>rewrite-maven-plugin</artifactId>

            <configuration>
              <failOnInvalidActiveRecipes>true</failOnInvalidActiveRecipes>

    <profile>
      <id>m3-openrewrite-mindexast-delivery</id>

        <plugins>
          <plugin>
            <groupId>org.openrewrite.maven</groupId>

            <configuration>
              <activeRecipes>

            </configuration>
          </plugin>
        </plugins>
      </build>
    </profile>
    <profile>
      <id>m3-openrewrite-mindexast</id>
      <build>
        <plugins>
          <plugin>
            <groupId>org.openrewrite.maven</groupId>
            <artifactId>rewrite-maven-plugin</artifactId>
            <version>${m3.iop.rewrite.plugin.version}</version>
            <configuration>
              <activeRecipes>
                <recipe>com.synexia.rewrite.M3OpenRewriteOnMIndexAstProofRecipe</recipe>
              </activeRecipes>
              <failOnInvalidActiveRecipes>true</failOnInvalidActiveRecipes>
              <exportDatatables>true</exportDatatables>
              <failOnDryRunResults>false</failOnDryRunResults>
            </configuration>
          </plugin>
        </plugins>
      </build>
    </profile>
    <profile>
      <id>m3-openrewrite-sourcej-mindex</id>
      <build>
        <plugins>
          <plugin>
            <groupId>org.openrewrite.maven</groupId>
            <artifactId>rewrite-maven-plugin</artifactId>
            <version>${m3.iop.rewrite.plugin.version}</version>
            <configuration>
              <activeRecipes combine.self="override">
                <recipe>com.synexia.rewrite.M3OpenRewriteSourceJInlineRecipe</recipe>
              </activeRecipes>
              <failOnInvalidActiveRecipes>true</failOnInvalidActiveRecipes>

    <!-- Mechanical Atomize/Patternize recipe mastery through in-memory compile/test convergence. -->
    <profile>
      <id>m3-recipe-laboratory</id>
      <properties>
        <m3.recipeLab.maxFeatures>2</m3.recipeLab.maxFeatures>
        <m3.recipeLab.maxFixtures>8</m3.recipeLab.maxFixtures>
        <m3.recipeLab.maxSequenceLength>2</m3.recipeLab.maxSequenceLength>
        <m3.recipeLab.maxCycles>4</m3.recipeLab.maxCycles>
        <m3.recipeLab.maxCandidates>16</m3.recipeLab.maxCandidates>
        <m3.recipeLab.report>${project.build.directory}/m3-recipe-laboratory/regression.tsv</m3.recipeLab.report>
      </properties>
      <build>
        <plugins>
          <plugin>
            <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
            <artifactId>maven-surefire-plugin</artifactId>
            <configuration combine.self="override">
              <useModulePath>false</useModulePath>
              <includes>
                <include>**/M3RecipeLaboratoryTest.java</include>
                <include>**/M3RecipeLaboratorySignalFanInTest.java</include>
              </includes>
              <failIfNoTests>true</failIfNoTests>
            </configuration>
          </plugin>
          <plugin>
            <groupId>org.jacoco</groupId>
            <artifactId>jacoco-maven-plugin</artifactId>
            <executions>
              <execution>
                <id>m3-recipe-laboratory-cache-agent</id>
                <goals><goal>prepare-agent</goal></goals>
              </execution>
              <execution>
                <id>m3-recipe-laboratory-cache-report</id>
                <phase>verify</phase>
                <goals><goal>report</goal></goals>
              </execution>
              <execution>
                <id>m3-recipe-laboratory-cache-check</id>
                <phase>verify</phase>
                <goals><goal>check</goal></goals>
                <configuration>
                  <includes>
                    <include>com/synexia/rewrite/M3RecipeLaboratory$EvaluationCache*</include>
                  </includes>
                  <rules>
                    <rule>
                      <element>BUNDLE</element>
                      <limits>
                        <limit>
                          <counter>LINE</counter>
                          <value>COVEREDRATIO</value>
                          <minimum>0.99</minimum>
                        </limit>
                        <limit>
                          <counter>BRANCH</counter>
                          <value>COVEREDRATIO</value>
                          <minimum>0.99</minimum>
                        </limit>
                      </limits>
                    </rule>
                  </rules>
                </configuration>
              </execution>
            </executions>
          </plugin>
          <plugin>
            <groupId>org.codehaus.mojo</groupId>
            <artifactId>exec-maven-plugin</artifactId>
            <executions>
              <execution>
                <id>m3-recipe-laboratory-regression</id>
                <phase>verify</phase>
                <goals><goal>java</goal></goals>
                <configuration>
                  <mainClass>com.synexia.rewrite.M3RecipeLaboratoryCli</mainClass>
                  <arguments>
                    <argument>${m3.recipeLab.report}</argument>
                    <argument>${m3.recipeLab.maxFeatures}</argument>
                    <argument>${m3.recipeLab.maxFixtures}</argument>
                    <argument>${m3.recipeLab.maxSequenceLength}</argument>
                    <argument>${m3.recipeLab.maxCycles}</argument>
                    <argument>${m3.recipeLab.maxCandidates}</argument>
                  </arguments>
                  <cleanupDaemonThreads>false</cleanupDaemonThreads>
                </configuration>
              </execution>
            </executions>
          </plugin>
        </plugins>
      </build>
    </profile>
